name: Braze Android SDK

dataTypes.when: Always: Braze collects session activity by default; other interactions depend on your custom events.

dataTypes.type: App info and performance / Crash logs
dataTypes.when: Always, for errors inside the Braze SDK (includes phone model, OS level and a Braze-specific user ID).

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always. Braze generates a device ID to tell devices apart and confirm messages reach the intended device.
If you send in-app messages or push through Braze: Braze records when users open or read them.

ask: Do you call changeUser() with an external user ID? If yes, declare Personal info / User IDs.

Do you set user attributes such as email, name, phone, gender, date of birth, home city or custom attributes? Declare Personal info / Email address, Name, Phone number, Other info (and Approximate location for home city) as applicable.
Do you use com.braze:android-sdk-location or setLastKnownLocation / geofences? If yes, declare Location / Approximate or Precise location (matching your location permission).
Do you log purchases (logPurchase)? If yes, declare Financial info / Purchase history.
Do you pass the Google Advertising ID to Braze? If yes, declare it under Device or other IDs and add Advertising or marketing as a purpose.
Do you use Braze for marketing campaigns? Add Advertising or marketing and/or Developer communications to the purposes.

sources.title: Manage Data Collection for the Braze SDK (Google Play privacy questionnaire)

notes: Braze's Google Play privacy questionnaire: the SDK 'collects data as configured by the app developer'; data processed per your instructions (service provider); encrypted in transit; users can request deletion. Approximate location, health, emails, user-generated content not collected by default. Purposes are not given per data type by Braze; those listed here are suggestions. The older URL /developer_guide/platforms/android/google_play_privacy returns 404.
